# dino-mcp — Full Context for AI Agents

> Complete project context (~15K tokens). AI agents: read this for full understanding before implementing.

---

## Project Identity

**Name**: dino-mcp
**Purpose**: Reference implementation of MCP Apps-enabled server with Go backend and TypeScript HTML UI.
**Version**: 0.1.0 (development)
**Go Version**: 1.25.0
**MCP SDK**: github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk v1.6.1
**HTTP Router**: github.com/gin-gonic/gin v1.12.0
**UI SDK**: @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps (TypeScript, Vite-bundled)

## Repository Structure

```
dino-mcp/
├── cmd/dino-mcp/main.go              # CLI: stdio, http, help
├── internal/
│   ├── server/server.go              # Composition root: New(), transports, Gin routes, CORS
│   ├── tools/
│   │   ├── tools.go                  # Shared types (DinoThinkResult, DinoSummary, constants)
│   │   ├── think.go                  # RegisterThink() — dino_think (random fact)
│   │   ├── ask.go                    # RegisterAsk() — dino_ask (Q&A)
│   │   └── dashboard.go              # RegisterDashboardTool() + FilteredDinosaurs(), dinoData
│   └── resources/
│       ├── resources.go              # Package doc
│       ├── dashboard.go              # RegisterDashboardResource() + //go:embed dashboard_ui.html
│       └── dashboard_ui.html         # Embedded MCP App HTML (Vite-built, ~354KB)
├── ui/
│   ├── src/mcp-app.ts                # App class with PostMessageTransport
│   ├── vite.config.ts                # vite-plugin-singlefile
│   ├── package.json, tsconfig.json
├── Makefile                          # build, run-*, test, dev-*, lint, clean, tunnel
├── go.mod / go.sum
├── AGENTS.md, SYSTEM.md, MEMORY.md, SKILL.md, PLAN.md, DESIGN.md
├── CODE_CONDUCT.md, CONTRIBUTOR.md
├── llms.txt, llms-full.txt
├── test_mcp.sh                       # 7 integration tests
└── docs/                             # Diátaxis: tutorials, how-to, reference, explanation, adr
```

## Key Implementation Details

### Server (server.go)
```go
// Transport modes
func RunStdio(ctx context.Context, s *mcp.Server, logger *slog.Logger) error
func RunStreamableHTTP(ctx context.Context, s *mcp.Server, addr string, logger *slog.Logger) error

// Gin routes
r.Any("/mcp", gin.WrapH(mcpHandler))          // MCP JSON-RPC
r.Any("/mcp/*any", gin.WrapH(mcpHandler))      // MCP subpaths
r.GET("/dashboard", dashboardHandler)           // Standalone HTML
r.GET("/dashboard/*any", dashboardHandler)      // Standalone subpaths
r.GET("/api/dinosaurs", apiDinosaurHandler)     // JSON data
r.GET("/health", healthHandler)                 // Health check

// Middleware
r.Use(gin.Recovery())       // Panic recovery
r.Use(ginLogger(logger))    // Request logging
r.Use(corsMiddleware())     // CORS headers
```

### Tool Registration
```go
// Text tool (no UI)
mcp.AddTool(s, &mcp.Tool{
    Name:        "dino_think",
    Description: "...",
    InputSchema: map[string]any{
        "type":       "object",
        "properties": map[string]any{},
    },
}, handler)

// MCP App tool (with UI)
mcp.AddTool(s, &mcp.Tool{
    Name:        "dino_dashboard",
    Description: "...",
    InputSchema: map[string]any{
        "type": "object",
        "properties": map[string]any{
            "filter": map[string]any{
                "type":        "string",
                "description": "Optional filter: 'carnivore', 'herbivore', 'jurassic', 'cretaceous', 'triassic'",
            },
        },
    },
    Meta: mcp.Meta{
        "ui": map[string]any{
            "resourceUri": "ui://dino-dashboard/mcp-app.html",
        },
    },
}, handler)
```

### Resource Registration
```go
s.AddResource(&mcp.Resource{
    URI:      "ui://dino-dashboard/mcp-app.html",
    Name:     "Dino Dashboard",
    MIMEType: "text/html;profile=mcp-app",
}, func(ctx context.Context, req *mcp.ReadResourceRequest) (*mcp.ReadResourceResult, error) {
    htmlData, _ := resources.DashboardHTML()
    return &mcp.ReadResourceResult{
        Contents: []*mcp.ResourceContents{
            {URI: req.Params.URI, MIMEType: "text/html;profile=mcp-app", Text: string(htmlData)},
        },
    }, nil
})
```

### View Protocol (mcp-app.ts)
```ts
import { App, PostMessageTransport } from "@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps";

const app = new App({ name: "Dino Dashboard", version: "0.1.0" });

app.ontoolinput = (params) => { /* streaming data */ };
app.ontoolresult = (result) => { /* final data */ };
app.onhostcontextchanged = (ctx) => { /* theme, fonts, safe area */ };
app.onteardown = async () => { /* cleanup */ };

await app.connect(new PostMessageTransport());
```

### Standalone Dashboard Fallback
```ts
// Detected in dashboard_ui.html
const standalone = window === window.parent;
if (standalone) {
    fetch('/api/dinosaurs')
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(data => showDashboard(data.dinosaurs));
} else {
    // PostMessage protocol with host
    await app.connect(new PostMessageTransport());
}
```

## Data Model

### DinoSummary (Go types / JSON shape)
```go
type DinoSummary struct {
    Name       string `json:"name"`
    Period     string `json:"period"`
    Diet       string `json:"diet"`
    Length     string `json:"length"`
    Weight     string `json:"weight"`
    FunFact    string `json:"funFact"`
    ImageStyle string `json:"imageStyle"`
}
```

### 12 Dinosaurs
Tyrannosaurus Rex, Triceratops, Stegosaurus, Velociraptor, Brachiosaurus, Spinosaurus, Ankylosaurus, Diplodocus, Parasaurolophus, Pachycephalosaurus, Raptor, Maiasaura

### API Response Format
```json
{
  "dinosaurs": [DinoSummary, ...],
  "filter": "Carnivore",
  "timestamp": "2026-06-21T00:00:00Z",
  "total": 4
}
```

## Transport Details

### Streamable HTTP
- Endpoint: `POST /mcp`
- Accept header must include `application/json` AND `text/event-stream`
- Response: SSE stream (`event: message\ndata: {...}`) or JSON object
- Session via `Mcp-Session-Id` header
- Requires CORS support (OPTIONS → 200)

### stdio
- Process launched by MCP client (Claude Desktop)
- JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout
- No CORS, no HTTP, no session management

## Integration Tests (test_mcp.sh)

7 tests run against live server on :9010:
1. Initialize → session ID returned
2. notifications/initialized → accepted
3. tools/list → dino_dashboard with _meta.ui.resourceUri
4. tools/call dino_think → random fact + species
5. tools/call dino_dashboard → filtered dinosaur list
6. resources/read → HTML with text/html;profile=mcp-app
7. tools/call dino_ask → Q&A result

## Environment
- Default port: :9010
- No API keys required
- Mode: gin.ReleaseMode or gin.DebugMode (verbose flag)
- Version injected via -ldflags at build time

## Known Issues & Pitfalls

1. SSE transport is REMOVED from MCP spec — use Streamable HTTP
2. CORS OPTIONS preflight must return 200 — required by browser MCP Inspector
3. Cloudflare Tunnel blocked by DNS rebinding protection — set DisableLocalhostProtection: true
4. MCP Apps must use ui/initialize protocol — NOT iframe-ready (MCP-UI) protocol
5. Accept header must include BOTH application/json AND text/event-stream
6. trycloudflare.com tunnels are temporary — restart generates new URL
7. _meta.ui.resourceUri uses nested {ui: {resourceUri: ...}} — flat format deprecated
